decisions.reason: The hierarchical search plugin builds directly on the firm's established web map search knowledge, and its own R&D allows it to learn from early results and improve the product.
The mobile map layer control component is closely related to existing GIS components and was highlighted on the home page, indicating the firm can assimilate user feedback and improve it.
As a flagship software platform central to the firm's strategic direction and deeply tied to its core GIS solution knowledge, withdrawing it is highly unlikely.
The mobile field data capture software leverages existing mobile and GIS capabilities and has a dedicated page, showing continued learning potential and market presence.
This search extension is close to the established web map application portfolio, and the firm's absorptive capacity supports keeping it to refine based on user feedback.
